description: The organization's setup state: name, type, default language, default home location, in-app setup-step progress, whether sample data is active, and counts. Categories, locations and people are each counted over the newest 500 rows, so a bigger organization reads as exactly 500, a lower bound rather than the total; members and items are exact (items = published items, personal drafts excluded); pending invites are exact and returned to admins only. `availableSetupTemplates` lists the templates get_setup_template serves.
name: get_setup_status

defaultCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code a NEW currency field gets when created without currencyCode (change with set_org_defaults)

defaultHomeLocation.description: Fallback home location for new items

orgType.description: school | company | publicAdmin | publicWorks | club | other; absent = never set

sampleDataActive.description: Whether demo records are currently loaded

setupSteps.description: Wizard bookkeeping: done/skipped per step; absent key = untouched

yourRole.description: The connected user's role: owner | manager | member | viewer

title: Get setup status
